scope: Local sample master; exact listed element sets only, with declared ratio filters. Additional dopants, missing listed elements, unsupported formulas, and off-ratio samples are excluded. Temperature points are deduplicated by sample_key. These are composition subsets, not the full existing material classes.
cutoff_rule: Scale full formula to declared tested-element coefficient sum; test only declared elements. Remove <= cutoff, except exactly equal two-element tested groups retained for this diagnostic. This tie extension beyond SiGe is not adopted policy. Framework elements are not tested; removed-all means tested group only.
